scheme.disposability_notice: This file is a derived, disposable display projection of the compiled ledger artifacts. It is never canonical truth and never alters ledger identity, hop counts, hop eligibility, dense-surface exclusions, or evidence semantics, which remain governed exclusively by BUILD-INSTRUCTIONS.md Section 1 and tools/build-hop-graph.mjs. Safe to delete and regenerate at any time with `node tools/build-atlas-projection.mjs`.
scheme.graph_effect_derivation_rule: graph_effect is copied/derived only from surface.hop_eligible (declared in the ledger surface record) and build/hop-graph.json rejected_hop_surfaces[].reason (computed by tools/lib/hops.mjs deriveHopEdges, never re-derived here):   hop_eligible=true, no rejection reason            -> "hop-eligible"   hop_eligible=true, reason=broad_institution_context_only -> "context-only"   hop_eligible=true, reason=fewer_than_two_actor_participants     or reason=density_limit_exceeded                -> "none" (structurally cannot hop)   hop_eligible=false, status is a scouted/candidate status     (candidate_pending_contract_receipt, seeded_from_public_post) -> "scout-only"   hop_eligible=false, any other declared status       -> "none" No graph_effect value is ever inferred from anything other than these source fields.
scheme.region_membership_basis: cases.json is the authoritative declared case list. build/surface-graph.json carries no per-surface case_id tag yet (a future ladder step), so every bounded surface is attributed to cases.json.default_case_id until finer per-surface case tagging exists. Regions for any other declared case are reported with an honest zero population, not guessed membership.
scheme.determinism_notice: No Date.now(), no Math.random(), no locale-dependent formatting. All arrays are sorted by stable string ids before serialization; all layout positions are seeded FNV-1a hashes of namespaced stable ids. Running this builder twice against an unchanged input tree produces byte-identical output.

surface_nodes.label: The Times names a business podcast after querying its Electric Twin synthetic panel, as reported 4 Nov 2025
bounded_by: Digiday report of on-stage remarks at the Digiday Publishing Summit Europe
surface_nodes.notes: Digiday reports Tracy Yaverbaun, gm of The Times and Sunday Times, saying The Times queried its synthetic research panel (built with Electric Twin from a reader panel drawn from 642,000 subscribers, plus a panel modelled on the broader British newsreading population) when naming a new business podcast; of about four names, "The Business" came up highest and was chosen. Acceptance-boundary fields per docs/performative-synthetic-constituency.md: question given (choose among about four podcast names); synthetic output given only as a ranking ("really, really high" with the target demographic); institutional disposition given (the name was adopted); rejected alternatives present but not named; model and version missing; complete option set missing; exposure policy missing; eligible population partly described; assignment mechanism, untreated evidence and post-intervention outcomes missing. Under the fixture this remains preference_identification_unavailable.

corridors.label: Policy creation → military advisory integration → personnel continuity → commercial deployment

stages.note: Clifford authors the commissioned AI Opportunities Action Plan; government accepts and operationalizes it.

Official Army records establish an organization-level channel that commissions senior technology executives as part-time Army Reserve advisers. The record does not establish a procurement award, contract, preferred-vendor status, company participation in Army decisions, or technology transfer.

Official records provide two dated observations of Warner in a No. 10 digital-and-data role. This stage preserves personnel chronology only and does not assert that later commercial methods originated in government.

First-party News UK and Electric Twin launch records describe an organization-level synthetic-audience deployment. Neither source identifies Ben Warner or a No. 10 colleague as a participant, and the stage does not establish method origin, transfer, replacement of all consultation, accuracy, privacy compliance, coordination, or motive.

graph_effect_basis.why_no_hop: No bounded surface carries shared Matt Clifford co-participation across these stages. The Detachment 201 program stage is organization-level context; its separate exact-date four-officer commissioning surface does not include Clifford. The No. 10 stage is a dated Ben Warner role observation, and the later News UK stage is an organization-only customer-vendor deployment. The chain remains a chronology for further testing rather than proof of procurement, co-presence across stages, method origin, transfer, motive, wrongdoing, coordination, or common purpose.
